rationale: Qwen3 1.7B failed a critical historical semantic regression at C3 and was not admitted to broader qualification.
The later C4 candidates either failed deterministic semantic/schema reliability or produced critical human-quality evidence-grounding defects.
Several candidates were operationally loadable, but hardware fit does not override critical analytical contract failures.

No candidate survived with the combined structured-output reliability, semantic correctness, evidence-role discipline, judgment-boundary compliance and usefulness required to justify repeatability and final blinded comparison as a production candidate.
The refreshed registry contains no currently verified same-weight candidate with sufficient incremental information gain to justify extending the campaign before this C7 decision.
non_conclusions: This does not conclude that all present or future local/open-weight models are unsuitable for OroTitan.
This does not infer a global failure of any model family.
This does not rank the failed candidates.
This does not select a best failed model or fallback model.
This does not authorize a paid model, hybrid architecture, new hardware purchase, or new candidate.
This does not freeze production routing.
